notes.title: Quality of Life Patch
notes.content:
1.2.1 is up with a few features to make things easier/accurate

[list]
[*] Factories should release path arrows on click and hold
[*] Tab now toggle bolt flinger on/off and is configurable
[*] Clicking another mouse button when using the bolt flinger will cancel it
[*] Camera movement no longer glides after releasing the button
[*] Lowered volume on building sound
[/list]

notes.title: The All Mighty Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Thanks for being some of the first! Got to some of the feedback mentioned, here are the updates:

[list]
[*] Prompt added encouraging players to click for faster shooting before they've clicked 100 times
[*] Added accessibility option that will auto click one Turbotz at a time
[*] Prompt added encouraging players to open ports if they never had and have extra bolts
[*] Panning the camera is now possible with both the middle and right mouse buttons. In addition to assigned movement keys.
[*] Rare bug that crashed on test load decided to make itself easy to fix today this patch
[/list]
